Yes, that's just what I hoped for. I clicked "Set aside to read" right on the CSS Grid card, its status flipped to "Read later," and when I opened the Read later view there it was — the same bookmark, not a duplicate copy. That's the key thing for me: it moved the one I already had rather than making a second one. Having that action sit on the card itself feels natural too.

That fully closes out what I asked for on read-later — I can set things aside before or after saving, and clear them once I've read them. This one's settled. Thanks for rounding it out.
